items.excerpt: NVIDIA introduced a synthetic video detector aimed at newsrooms and broadcasters at SIGGRAPH 2026, analysing footage frame-by-frame with up to 92% accuracy on uncompressed video. The same announcement opens NVIDIA tooling to MCP-driven AI agents inside production software.
items.title: NVIDIA tackles deepfakes and opens the door to AI agents at SIGGRAPH 2026

items.excerpt: UC Riverside researchers built SAGA, a forensic framework that reads the fingerprints a generator leaves in frame-to-frame variation. It aims to answer not just whether a clip is AI, but which model made it.
items.title: This New Tool Aims to Be Able to Identify and Trace AI Videos Back to Their Sources

items.excerpt: YouTube spelled out which AI-made video stops earning money: generic mass-produced clips, repetitive templates and fake personas dispensing serious advice. The rules redraw the line between AI-assisted craft and AI-generated filler for anyone shipping video at volume.
items.title: YouTube explains its AI slop policy and why some creators won't get paid

items.excerpt: Director c. Craig walks through the hand-made animation of Tribeca short ChikaBOOM! and pushes back on calling generative work 'artificial'. His argument: generative tools only hold up when the craft and labour behind them are visible.
items.title: Practice Makes Magic: The Human Hands Behind ChikaBOOM!

items.excerpt: Elon Musk says Grok Imagine will deliver a full 'historically accurate' Odyssey by December, positioning it against Nolan's version. RedShark walks the sample footage and the gap between the claim and what generative video actually holds together at feature length.
items.title: Elon Musk claims Grok will make a 'historically accurate' Odyssey by the end of the year

items.excerpt: A look at AI-assisted script coverage: Greenlight Coverage scores screenplays with data science to estimate audience and distribution before a frame is shot. Development notes move from taste to model output.
items.title: From Script to $100K Equity Financing: Navigating The Greenlight List

items.excerpt: The ASC released StEM3, a free standardised toolkit of Unreal Engine environments and test material for validating an LED volume before the shoot. It targets calibration, dynamic range and panel mismatch problems that quietly wreck in-camera VFX.
items.title: StEM3: Know your LED volume before you shoot

items.excerpt: Spider-Noir carries 3,250 VFX shots across eight episodes and a dual black-and-white look built for Nicolas Cage's middle-aged hero. The team tuned webs, movement and grade so the ageing body reads in every shot.
items.title: Double Dosing on the Visual Effects for Spider-Noir

items.excerpt: VFX supervisor Enrik Pavdeja breaks down the climbing and whitewater work behind Netflix survival thriller Apex. The challenge was keeping Charlize Theron's Australian-wilderness sequences physically believable shot to shot.
items.title: All the surprising rock climbing and kayaking VFX challenges on 'Apex'

items.excerpt: Issue #63 digs into the visual effects of 28 Years Later with Union Visual Effects. The production shot on iPhones and custom camera arrays, then built the abandoned landscapes and action digitally around them.
items.title: Zombies, iPhones and VFX

items.excerpt: Blackmagic shipped DaVinci Resolve 21.0.4 with Sony FX5 X-OCN support and smarter proxy relinking across mixed formats. A maintenance release, but it lands the FX5 in the grading suite days after the camera hit sets.
items.title: DaVinci Resolve 21.0.4 adds Sony FX5 X-OCN support and proxy relinking

items.excerpt: A compositing fundamentals refresher: match exposure and colour with waveforms before you trust any mask or key. The manual counterweight to one-click AI matting in Premiere.
items.title: Tool Tip Tuesday for Adobe Premiere Pro: Getting your Mask/Key to look real

items.excerpt: Supervising sound editor Wade Barnett details five seasons of building The Boys' 'diabolical with a side of gore' soundscape across dialogue, ADR, effects and Foley. His toolkit stays iZotope RX, Soundminer and Krotos rather than generative audio.
items.title: Wade Barnett on Emmy-Nominated Sound Editing of The Boys

items.excerpt: Showrunner Megan Gallagher on running post for All Her Fault across Oslo, London, LA, Melbourne and Chicago. A picture of how a distributed post pipeline actually gets held together.
items.title: Megan Gallagher Talks Post on Emmy-Nominated All Her Fault
